rows.coder_note: Abstract gives the FinnGen study with endpoint case and control counts only (6753 cases, 302 401 controls); no release number, accession or citation.

Passages say the pulmonary heart disease summary statistics were downloaded from the UK Biobank study (6038 cases, 426 977 controls, European) with no accession, citation, resource name or release; counts with a cohort name alone do not identify a release (rule I1).

rows.quote: Publicly available pQTLs datasets for human plasma proteins were obtained from a large‐scale GWAS by Sun et al, who measured 3622 plasma proteins in 3301 healthy European blood donors from the INTERVAL study using an aptamer‐based multiplex protein assay (SOMAscan). 13
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the exact N 3301 with the SOMAscan platform, 3622 proteins, INTERVAL and Sun et al, matching the Sun 2018 row alone; Table 1 gives PMID 29875488 and N 3301, no conflict. Ref 13 carries only the preprint DOI 10.1101/230094, so it is not used as a companion source.
